scope: Fresh review of the prepared GitHub-native profile application: README text/links/image semantics, proposed profile fields and pins, native reading hierarchy and supplied local rendered preview. The future heyNag.com continuity contract is assessed as a plan only. Prior mascot/studio scores are not inherited as profile approval.
sourceVerification: Manifest SHA256 and all nine listed source/asset hashes independently match. No source edits, browser use, web research, publication or partner-new-review reading occurred.

skillsReviewed.catalogAndRouting: The all-17 Emil catalogue intake is preserved from the implementation review; current brand/workflow.json interaction routing read. No claim of reading all 17 full skills. No new full animation review/performance or break-ui execution is claimed for this static GitHub application.
skillsReviewed.application: Use grounded copy, existing identity, native text and actual narrow/theme rendering. Keep purposeful still imagery and distinguish source/preview evidence from native input, spoken AT and physical hardware.

workflowChanges: Review only what the profile author controls: meaningful Markdown headings, link names/context, alt text, factual profile fields and exported assets. Record host-controlled layout/interaction separately.
Use actual wheel-scrolled narrow viewport captures for reading and pin claims; do not treat full-page sticky-navigation artifacts as a content defect.
Validate the project-reading path with images conceptually absent: the introduction, project names and purposes remain native text, and no essential meaning relies on the moth gesture or theme color.
Keep application readiness, publishing success and future website implementation as three separate evidence scopes. A locally injected preview must retain its unpublished label in review materials.

At future website integration, carry the same factual project labels and native-link clarity forward; observe keyboard/AT and reduced-motion paths on the built surface instead of inheriting this static review.

rulesNotApplicableWithReason.rule: Taste skill one/two screens per section, custom hero deal, copied starter assets, special fonts, hover motion and custom visual effects
rulesNotApplicableWithReason.reason: This is an authored GitHub README inside a host-owned layout, not a commercial website build. Custom CSS/JS and fixed viewport recipes are outside the supported application; adding them would not improve native profile operability.

rulesNotApplicableWithReason.rule: Taste skill contact placeholders, transactional CTA and invented business category
rulesNotApplicableWithReason.reason: This is Nag's real personal profile. Preserve authentic name and verified personal repositories; do not add fake contacts, buyer claims or an unfinished website destination.

The assignment is an independent source/render-evidence review, root owns the browser, and the preview uses GitHub's real DOM with Markdown API output. No custom standalone page was built by this reviewer; no checker pass is claimed.

rulesNotApplicableWithReason.rule: Animation timing, GPU/pose-continuity rules and playback controls from prior studio reviews
rulesNotApplicableWithReason.reason: The README adds static PNGs and native text/links, with no authored animation, sound, custom input or player. Those prior motion defects/limits are not mechanically imported into this new scope.

rulesNotApplicableWithReason.rule: Mobile-native app-shell locks or removal of host link feedback
rulesNotApplicableWithReason.reason: GitHub owns these controls and this is a scrolling document. Keep native navigation, scrolling and zoom rather than attempting custom gesture behavior.

scoreMeaning: Strong prepared native-profile interaction and reading design: essential content is text, destinations are named, imagery is static and supported by alt text, and inspected narrow/light/dark previews are coherent. This fresh 8.9/10 judges the local application, not the previous mascot, published account, full accessibility conformance, future website or audience outcomes.

confidence.previewGeometry: high within recorded 320/390/768/1024/1440 widths and two themes

strengths.finding: Essential information stays in native text.
strengths.why: Nag's introduction, private-work context, each project purpose and all three destinations remain readable independently of the decorative identity treatment. No hover, animation or tiny gesture is needed to understand what is shared.

strengths.finding: Named destinations and clear context support navigation.
strengths.evidence: README.md project links; profile.json pins; render-checks.json link arrays; pins-light-320-scroll.png
strengths.why: Charms, Grok Bot and eva.md links have concrete adjacent descriptions rather than repeated generic Learn more labels. The proposed fields omit unfinished heyNag.com rather than presenting a dead next step.

strengths.finding: The header has a concise meaningful text alternative and a static fallback.
strengths.why: The alt text includes heyNag and the curious moth; the fallback light PNG is explicitly present. The banner supplies identity while adjacent native headings and profile text carry authorship and purpose. The static treatment introduces no pause or reduced-motion burden.

strengths.finding: The authored content fits the inspected narrow native layout in both themes.
strengths.why: Name, bio, introduction, project paragraphs and pin descriptions wrap visibly within the provided content width; links remain distinguishable. Recorded document widths match viewports at all ten width/theme combinations. This is geometry evidence, not a physical-device pass.

strengths.finding: Personal identity and project context are consistent without a mascot interaction gate.
strengths.evidence: profile-light/dark-1440.png, 320px top captures, profile.json and continuity.json
strengths.why: Full name, handle, day avatar and header establish a coherent introduction. The planned website explicitly keeps real work visible without interacting with the moth and preserves static/reduced-motion paths.

deductions.confidence: high for repetition; medium for its user cost
deductions.finding: The bio and README opening repeat software/systems, curious experiments, useful tools and how software feels. On the narrow layout, a visitor reads substantially similar positioning twice before reaching the project links. It is not an access failure, but slightly reduces information gained while scrolling.
deductions.improvementCriterion: In a later copy pass, let the README opening contribute a concrete additional idea or shorten the repeated phrasing while retaining the warm first-person introduction and honest private-work context; do not change host layout to force an artificial first fold.

deductions.kind: validation limitation, not a confirmed defect
deductions.finding: The evidence shows local injected rendering and recorded link values/theme images, not an actual keyboard traversal or spoken-screen-reader reading of the proposed profile. Physical-phone zoom/landscape and GitHub theme-setting combinations outside the recorded light/dark conditions are also unobserved. Native Markdown is a sound foundation, but does not itself establish those outcomes.
deductions.improvementCriterion: When validating the applied profile, perform a bounded keyboard traversal of the three project links and a heading/image/link spoken-output check, confirm image fallback/theme behavior and inspect real-phone zoom/landscape. Keep unpublished or unobserved results labelled accurately.

recommendations: Accept this as a prepared local GitHub application with the named limits; no interaction source defect blocks paired review.
Retain native Markdown text, descriptive project-link context, concise image alt text, static PNGs and the omission of an unfinished website URL.
Treat the possible bio/intro consolidation as a small content refinement, not a reason to add custom layout or forced navigation.
Carry keyboard/spoken-output/hardware verification into the eventual application check; do not report this preview as published or fully accessibility-tested.

continuityAssessment.planQuality: The continuity contract is coherent for interaction: same maker/project names and source assets, plain useful explanations, work accessible without mascot interaction, static/reduced-motion equivalents, no forced audio and no automatic redirects.
continuityAssessment.futureRequirements: When the website exists, verify actual reading order, keyboard access, focus handling, project navigation and reduced-motion equivalence on that implementation. Shared visuals do not automatically transfer GitHub's native behavior or prove recognition.
continuityAssessment.notYetApproved: The future website is unbuilt and untested. No website interaction score or release approval is assigned. Adding heyNag.com only when it is a useful live destination is appropriate.

unscoredOutcomes: Published GitHub account settings or successful publication
Live keyboard behavior and spoken-screen-reader output for this application
Unfamiliar-human recognition, project discovery, comprehension or delayed recall
Built website quality and cross-surface recognition
Any motion/audio performance; this application is static
independence: Saved before reading any other new independent reviewer record.
